columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a subscription. It is generated during subscription creation and depends on all attributes of the subscription. A subscription that is identical to an existing one will not be created, but the identifier of the existing one is returned.

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates whether a subscription is created internally for integrated applications or via public API.

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_FIELDS
columns.description: List of fields that the subscription needs for filtering events and for adding to the events.

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_TITLE
columns.description: Optional human-readable title of the subscription.

columns.name: PUSH_TO_URL
columns.description: URL of an integrated system to which the events are to be pushed. It is used by an internal service for the integration that do not pull events but rather expect the events to be periodically pushed to them.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a REST Application that was used to create the subscription. Only application that created the subscription may request the events.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: Reference to FFS_USER associated with API application used to create the subscription.

columns.name: CREATED_TIME
columns.description: Date and time when the subscription was created. Unix timestamp format.

columns.name: EXPIRATION_TIME
columns.description: Subscription expiration date and time. Unix timestamp format.

columns.name: LAST_REQUESTED_PAGE
columns.description: Last value of the 'page' parameter used by 'get events' that was successfully processed for this subscription.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
